item.title: Hahaoya Saimin Nikki ~Tamaki Sachiko no Ganbou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bitter half
  • 発売日: 2015-04-24
  • スコア: 5.8100000000000005/10 (17 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 母親催眠日記 ～環幸子の願望～
  • 英語名: Hahaoya Saimin Nikki Tamaki Sachiko no Ganbou

あらすじ

Sachiko Tamaki, the mother of the protagonist, is devoted to his education, and her goal is to turn him into an elite. Sachiko had originally intended to become a bureaucrat, but her marriage has closed the door to that goal.

Sachiko has been giving him a gifted education since he was a child. However, the overbearing, restricting, and simply painful life he leads fosters in him anger toward his mother and a distorted desire to make amends for his past resentment.

  • 英語名: Hahaoya Saimin Nikki Otto no Inai Aida ni…

あらすじ

The mother is a well-behaved, modest, and chaste woman. However, since her husband is often away on business, the protagonist accidentally observes her masturbating.

He uses hypnosis on his mother, and succeeds in depriving her of her freedom.

“I’m going to tell your father!”

The mother is so fretful, but as the protagonist caresses her and uses sex toys on her, she gradually begins to let out a seductive moan.

item.title: Hitozuma Un'yu Saimin NTR Ben
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bitter half
  • 発売日: 2014-03-28
  • スコア: 5.61/10 (31 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 人妻運輸・催眠NTR便
  • 英語名: Hitozuma Un’yu Saimin NTR Ben

あらすじ

Ken’ichi Kodaka majored in psychology in college. He uses the “results” of his research to destroy those around him. He was kicked out of the university and became a criminal.

He decided to hide out in the dormitory of a shipping company in a countryside town. He wants to quit the shipping company immediately, but what holds him back is the cost of living and his dark desire for Yukie Yoshizumi, the managing director of the company.
